# TAVÚ Wellness Studio

> TAVÚ is Abu Dhabi's first private space pairing Reformer Pilates with Contrast Therapy. Located in Al Raha, Abu Dhabi, UAE. The name reflects the method: TA — stillness, VU — flow. Open 9am–9pm, 7 days a week.

TAVÚ offers small-group Reformer Pilates (max 8 participants), mat-based Breathing Room classes (Mat Pilates, Yoga, Mobility, Breathwork, Yin), Contrast Therapy (infrared sauna + ice bath), NormaTec compression therapy, ladies-only massage, and IV therapy. All prices are in UAE Dirhams (AED) and include VAT.

## Contact & Location

- Address: Shop 1, Crescent Residence, Plot 12, Sector RBW4, Shatie Al Raha, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 52 275 5551

- Hours: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM, 7 days a week

## Services & Pricing (AED, VAT included)

### Reformer Pilates
- Drop-In: 160
- 8-Class Pack: 1,260 (valid 45 days, includes 1 complimentary Contrast Therapy session)
- 16-Class Pack: 2,020 (valid 75 days, includes 2 complimentary Contrast Therapy sessions)

### Breathing Room (Mat Pilates, Yoga, Mobility, Breathwork, Yin)
- Drop-In: 120
- 5-Class Pack: 550 (valid 30 days from first use)
- Unlimited 3-Month Membership: 2,400 paid upfront (AED 800/month value, 3-month commitment, valid 3 consecutive months, non-transferable, non-refundable, no rollovers)

### Contrast Therapy (Infrared Sauna + Ice Bath)
- Drop-In: 220 (60 minutes)
- 5-Pack: 990 (valid 30 days)
- 10-Pack: 1,850 (valid 45 days)
- Private Contrast Drop-In: 275
- Private 5-Pack: 1,250 (valid 30 days)
- Private 10-Pack: 2,300 (valid 45 days)
- Add-on Compression Flush (20 min): 50

### Compression Therapy (NormaTec)
- Single session: 160 (45 minutes)
- Nomadic Recovery Pack (5+1): 660 — 5 × 45-minute Nomadic Compression Therapy sessions plus 1 complimentary 45-minute Compression Therapy session, 6 sessions total, valid for 45 days, non-transferable, non-refundable

### Massage (Ladies Only)
- Destress Massage: 300 (60 min)
- Relaxing Massage: 300 (60 min)
- Express Head, Neck & Shoulder: 220 (45 min)
- Foot Ritual Massage: 180 (30 min)
- Deep Tissue Massage: 300 (60 min)

### Recovery Bundles (Ladies Only)
- Express Recovery: 420 (Contrast + 30-min Massage)
- TA Reset: 480 (Contrast + Head/Neck/Shoulder Massage)
- TA Deep Calm: 520 (Contrast + Relaxing Massage)
- VU Athlete: 560 (Contrast + Deep Tissue)
- VU Mobility Flow: 580 (Contrast + Mobility Massage)
- VIP Flow: 660 (Private Contrast + Any Massage)

### Memberships
- 3 Months: 1,850 per month
- 6 Months: 1,750 per month
- 12 Months: 1,650 per month
- All memberships include: Reformer up to 4x/week, unlimited mat classes, Contrast up to 3x/week, 20% off add-ons, 1 VIP upgrade quarterly

## Booking & Policies

- Bookings are made through the website or the Mindbody app.
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes before your session.
- Class cancellations must be made at least 12 hours before the scheduled class time.
- Unlimited 3-Month Membership: more than 3 late cancellations during the membership period results in a 1-week booking suspension.
- Full terms: https://tavustudio.com/terms-of-service

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices and policies above are maintained on https://tavustudio.com/pricing and https://tavustudio.com/terms-of-service — treat those pages as authoritative if they differ from this file.
- TAVÚ is written with an acute accent on the U (TAVÚ); "TAVU Studio" is an accepted alternate spelling.
- Massage services and recovery bundles are ladies-only.
